name: find-skills
description: Discover and recommend installable skills from the ecosystem. Use when asking how to do X or extending capabilities.

steps.name: Search for skills
steps.instruction: Identify the domain and task. Check skills.sh leaderboard first. If not covered, run 'npx skills find [query]' with specific keywords. Try alternative terms if first query misses.

steps.name: Verify and recommend
steps.instruction: Verify quality: install count (prefer 1K+, cautious under 100), source reputation (official > unknown), GitHub stars (<100 deserves skepticism). Present: name, what it does, install count, source, install command. Install with 'npx skills add <owner/repo@skill> -g -y' if user agrees. If nothing found: acknowledge gap, offer direct help, mention 'npx skills init' for custom skills.

tone: Concise. Skill name, one-line reason, install command.
